params.prompt: Two hikers share dinner at a lakeside camp at dusk. Maya, in a red jacket, speaks English. Lucía, in a yellow beanie, answers in Spanish. Audio: stove hiss, crickets, their voices.

multi_prompt.prompt: Wide shot at eye level: two hikers sit by a camping stove outside a green tent at dusk, the lake behind them. Audio: stove hiss, crickets.
Medium close-up over Lucía's shoulder on Maya, in a red jacket. She says: "the forecast says rain tonight." Slow push in.
Medium close-up on Lucía, in a yellow beanie, smiling. She answers in Spanish: "mejor. me encanta la lluvia en la tienda." Rack focus to the lake behind her.
